samples.question: Four dot-numbered stations start with the links shown. Read the six cards from left to right. A green LINK card adds the undirected link between its two dot-numbered stations; a red CUT card removes that link. Adding an existing link or cutting a missing link does nothing. After all six cards, is there a path of links between the two magenta-ringed stations? Answer yes or no.
